Question: Jerry starts at \(0\) on the real number line. He tosses a fair coin \(8\) times. When he gets heads, he moves \(1\) unit in the positive direction; when he gets tails, he moves \(1\) unit in the negative direction. The probability that he reaches \(4\) at some time during this process is \(\dfrac{a}{b},\) where \(a\) and \(b\) are relatively prime positive integers. What is \(a+b?\) (For example, he succeeds if his sequence of tosses is HTHHHHHH.)
